blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Following decades of armed conflict and security challenges, the Province of Sulu was officially declared having a state of Stable Internal Peace and Security (SIPS) during a ceremony at the provincial gymnasium on Thursday, Sept. 24. The declaration was formalized through Provincial Peace and Order Council Resolution No. 3, Series of 2026, which affirmed that insurgent formations in the province have been dismantled and degraded to a non-threat level.
